name: smwgraphics-retry-neon-nights
title: Retry - Neon Nights
description:
Graphics based from a forgotten Rovio mobile game named "Retry". This graphics comes from the game futuristic world, and the name came from the music heard on the same levels.

Should be used on abstract or industrial levels.

Uses the second half of palette rows 4 and 5.

Credit not required, but very appreciated.
